context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 断固/刻ま/在学/将校/忠誠/一変/苦難/体格

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、断固として、対応してまいります、絶対、市民の安全、守り抜きます、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: We will respond to this case with absolute firmness. We will protect our citizens' safety—no matter what.
lines.style: Steady, official opening. Measured cadence with slight emphasis on 「firm」and 「protect」. Breath support underneath. Not robotic—genuine resolve tempered with the weight of responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者のお名前、慰霊碑に、刻まれることに、なったんですね、本当に、悲しい、出来事でした。
lines.en: His name will be carved into the memorial. It really was such a tragic incident.
lines.style: Slow, somber. Pause after the first clause—letting the weight settle. Soft voice, looking inward. Trailing off slightly on 「tragic」 as if the reality still hasn't fully landed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、在学中の学生でした、本当に、若い人材、失われた、悲しい、事件です、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The suspect was still a student—so young. It's heartbreaking to see such potential lost in such a terrible case.
lines.style: Official but with quiet human ache beneath. Even pacing, but a catch of sadness on 「young」. Not performing sorrow—just acknowledging it while maintaining professional composure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の将校が、犯した事件、ニュースで、目に、しましたね、本当に、深刻な、社会問題、ですね。
lines.en: I've seen those news reports about past cases involving officers. It really is a serious social issue, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching tone. Slightly hesitant—he's trying to understand, not accuse. Gentle rise at the end, genuinely asking. Unrushed, giving space for an honest answer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。警察官、忠誠心、本当に、強い職業、ですよね、私たち、誇りに、思って、活動しております、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Police officers—loyalty is at the core of what we do. It's a profession we take great pride in, and that's how we work.
lines.style: Measured, grounded. Pride in 「loyalty」without defensiveness. Matter-of-fact but warm. Speaking from inside the profession, not explaining it from outside.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件で、地域、雰囲気、一変、しましたよね、警察、心のケア、提供されているの、立派ですね、本当に。
lines.en: This case really has changed the atmosphere in the community. It's admirable how the department is providing emotional support.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, spoken softly. Observant—he notices what others might miss. Warm but not effusive. The respect is real and quietly offered.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。苦難を、乗り越えて、地域、本気で、再生してまいります、警察、全力で、応援、絶対、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We will move through this hardship and genuinely work to restore the community. The police department will do everything in our power—absolutely.
lines.style: Firm resolve returning. Deliberate pacing on 「restore」. Voice carries both commitment and acknowledgment of the weight ahead. Not quick or rushed—each word carries intention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の体格、目撃者の証言と、一致したんですね、本当に、捜査、進んでいるんですね、ありがたいです、本当に。
lines.en: The suspect's physical description matched the witness testimony exactly. The investigation really is progressing. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Relief and cautious optimism. The facts are solid ground. Slightly warmer tone than his previous turns—grateful that at least this piece is moving forward. Respectful, not triumphant.
